title: Nitrosamines FREE Technology
excerptHtml: Nitrosamines are chemical compounds of the chemical structure R1N(–R2)–N=O and are used in the manufacture of rubber products. Nitrosamines can cause Cancers. Currently available epidemiological evidence from case-control studies on nitrite and nitrosamine intake supports a positive association with gastric cancer risk.
